description: Source code for the SqlPropertyValueStore class managing property values in a SQL database, including create, read, update, delete, search, and upsert operations.

classes.name: SqlPropertyValueStore
classes.description: A store class for managing property values in a SQL database, supporting CRUD operations and search.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new property value record in the database.

methods.name: CreateMany
methods.description: Creates multiple property value records in a transaction.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a property value by ID and group ID.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves multiple property values by their IDs and optional group ID.

methods.name: SearchPropertyValues
methods.description: Searches for property values based on various filtering options.

methods.name: Upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates property values with conflict resolution.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Marks a property value as deleted by setting DeleteAt timestamp.

methods.name: DeleteForField
methods.description: Marks property values for a specific field as deleted.

methods.name: DeleteForTarget
methods.description: Deletes property values for a specific target type and ID.
